summary_md: **Broccoliiiii ([@Keepurselfaliv3](https://x.com/Keepurselfaliv3/status/2116749449968095527))** open-sourced **MoMo Agent**, a self-hosted wearable agent where Apple Watch and earphones capture context transcribed locally on iPhone, and a Mac agent on your Claude or Codex subscription remembers and proactively acts ([Miri-Labs/MoMo-Agent](https://github.com/Miri-Labs/MoMo-Agent)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - Miri-Labs/MoMo-Agent: Open-Source, Self-Hosted, All-Day Wearable Personal Agent for Apple Watch, iPhone, and Mac

relevance: Proactive personal agent with local capture.

media.description: MoMo Agent overview: Apple Watch captures, iPhone transcribes locally for $0, Mac mini runs the agent.
MoMo Agent screens: Apple Watch all-day capture, chat and watch status, transcript timeline, and skip-silence playback.
MoMo Agent proactive background execution: Mac agent with sub-agent tasks and a live iPhone tasks sheet.
MoMo Agent long-term personal memory and pluggable self-hosted runtime settings.
